facts.note: The hill the hall is cut into is forty blocks east to west: the hall, the stores beside it and the rock round both.
Forty blocks north to south, the loft north of the hall and rock on every side.
Thirty-two blocks from under the cellar to over the loft's roof.
Eight blocks floor to vault in the hall, so the loft's barred passage stands above head height and is looked up at from the muster floor.
The hall is sixteen blocks across: room for three of the levy to form up and a party to fight them.
The cellar floor is four blocks under the hall floor: a drop a body takes without harm, and a climb a ladder makes.
